stages.native:
select coalesce(dim_product.category_name, '미분류') as category_name, sum(fct_order_item.line_gross_value) as category_gmv
from facts.fct_order_item
inner join dimensions.dim_product on fct_order_item.product_id = dim_product.product_id
inner join dimensions.dim_date on fct_order_item.purchase_date_key = dim_date.date_key
where fct_order_item.order_status = 'DELIVERED'
[[and {{utc_order_date}}]]
group by coalesce(dim_product.category_name, '미분류')
order by category_gmv desc

description: 배송 완료(DELIVERED) 주문에 속한 항목만 집계한다. 상품 항목 Grain. line_gross_value를 카테고리별로 합산하며 주문 Fact를 결합하지 않는다.
name: Category GMV
